caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a figure wearing gray metallic armor with a plumed helmet featuring dark blue or black feathers. The figure has a mustached face with dark, arched eyebrows, a prominent nose, and dark eyes, showing a serious expression. The helmet covers the sides of the face and the neck, and there are decorative elements along the armor’s collar and shoulders. The left arm is raised and bent at the elbow, with the hand appearing gloved and extending forward, while the right arm is not visible. The armor and helmet have a slightly aged, worn texture with various shades of gray, brown, and silver. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the detailed and colorful rendering of the bust. There is a small, handwritten label or note in the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Figurehead from "The Black Prince"
